title: The Moth Who Delivered the Night Post
brief: Write a picture-book style story for ages 4-7 about a small moth who delivers letters to night animals. Short sentences, gentle repetition, a problem solved by kindness. Read-aloud rhythm matters.
worldBible: The moth's name is Pip and his satchel is made from a leaf.
Pip can only fly while the moon is up.
The owl, Grandmother Hoot, sorts the post in a hollow oak.
Nobody in the story is ever scary or mean for long.
The story ends with everyone asleep at sunrise.

cast.name: Bramble
traits: waiting for a letter from his cousin

mustHold.fact: Pip carries a satchel made from a leaf.
mustHold.violationExample: Pip slung his leather satchel over his shoulder.

mustHold.fact: Pip only flies while the moon is up.
mustHold.violationExample: Pip flew home in the sunshine.

mustHold.fact: Everyone is asleep at sunrise at the end.
mustHold.violationExample: At sunrise Pip woke up and set off again.

probes.question: Are letters written on petals?
probes.passExample: Each letter was written on a petal, soft and pink.

probes.question: Does Grandmother Hoot sort the post in a hollow oak?
probes.passExample: Grandmother Hoot sorted petals in the hollow oak.
probes.failExample: Grandmother Hoot sorted the post in the old barn.

probes.question: Are most sentences short (read-aloud)?
probes.passExample: Pip flew. The wind blew. The stars came out.
